_comment: Mushroom — the 'walker': patrols at speed, turning at walls and ledges (ledge_probe px of drop). When the player is within spore_range and the puff is off cooldown it stops, tells, plays the spore clip and drops a one-hit spore cloud cloud_offset in front of itself that lingers cloud_lifetime. Touch damage 1. Numbers in px, px/s, seconds.
